desc:
Fly a rocket car and escape the police! 🚨🚀

🚓 NEW: POLICE CHASE
• A big daytime city, open right after the tutorial
• Drive up walls and launch off the roofs
• Cars, drones and a helicopter hunt you
• No hiding in the sky: land and hide in garages and tunnels
• Daily bounties and a weekly escape board

🏁 40 STAGES IN FOUR WORLDS
• City, space, lava and ice
• Pick Easy, Normal or Hard
• Stunt Park for tricks and rings

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
• W drive, A/D steer
• Hold SPACE to fly, tap to hop
• F to flip
• 📱 Phone: stick + THRUST and FLIP buttons

🎨 Paints, wraps, wheels and trails
📅 7-day streak: free exhaust, paint + Titan Truck
🎁 Use code OG for a free limited paint!

👑 VIP: 2x coins, unlimited skips and gas, +25% speed, Titan Truck

📱 Phone, tablet, PC and controller
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more!

⚠️This is a fan-made Roadster game. We are not associated with Tesla Roadster ⚠️
